title.zh: 将巴拉望省普林塞萨港市副区工程办公室重新划为正式工程区办公室，名称为巴拉望第三工程区
title.en: An Act Reclassifying the Sub-District Engineering Office in the City of Puerto Princesa, Province of Palawan, into a Regular Engineering District Office to be known as the Third Engineering District of Palawan
title.orig: An Act Reclassifying the Sub-District Engineering Office in the City of Puerto Princesa, Province of Palawan, into a Regular Engineering District Office to be known as the Third Engineering District of Palawan

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2000/ra_8965_2000.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The present sub-district engineering office in the City of Puerto Princesa, Province of Palawan, created pursuant to Department Order No. 131 dated 08 July 1994, issued by the Secretary of Public Works and Highways, is hereby upgraded into a regular engineering district to be known as the Third Engineering District of Palawan, covering as its jurisdiction the City of Puerto Princesa.
The Secretary of Public Works and Highways shall issue the necessary rules, orders and circulars to implement the provisions of this Act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
